players.product: Jenbacher gas engines and gensets (Type 6 / J624 platform; containerized 5 MW units and multi-pack configurations) for behind-the-meter prime and backup power at AI data centers; Jenbacher power-solutions gensets (utility, peaker, biogas); Waukesha gas compression engines; lifecycle services

quarterly_data.signal: Follow-on data-center order: INNIO received a 620 megawatt (MW) follow-on order, booked in September 2026, from a leading developer and operator of mega-scale U.S. data center campuses (not named, per data-center confidentiality practice); together with the customer's 1.1 GW order announced in July 2026, cumulative orders from the customer are approximately 1.72 GW. All 620 MW will be delivered as containerized Jenbacher J624 solutions. The customer also signed a long-term full maintenance agreement covering the first 500 MW of the previously ordered capacity, including all spare parts and labor through a major overhaul. CEO Dr. Olaf Berlien: 'Repeat orders of this scale, combined with long-term service agreements, strengthen our backlog and expand the services base that underpins our business model.'
quarterly_data.figure: 620 MW follow-on order; approximately 1.72 GW cumulative from the customer; 500 MW maintenance agreement
